simple.prompt: Look at those dark skies; it ___ rain this afternoon.
simple.explanation: Modal might menyatakan kemungkinan masa depan yang tentatif (uncertain possibility).

simple.prompt: He isn't in his office; he ___ be in the conference hall.
simple.explanation: May be menyatakan kemungkinan spekulasi saat ini (present possibility).

simple.targetSentence: This proposal could solve our problem.
simple.explanation: Subject + could + base verb (solve) + our problem.

simple.prompt: She has been working for 14 hours straight; she ___ be exhausted.
simple.explanation: Must digunakan untuk deduksi kepastian logis kuat (strong logical deduction).
hints: Deduksi logis pasti setelah 14 jam bekerja.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat deduksi negatif dengan can't be.
simple.explanation: Deduksi ketidakmungkinan logis: can't be true.

simple.prompt: Where are my keys? — They ___ be in your coat pocket.
simple.explanation: Might be menyatakan kemungkinan tebakan yang masuk akal.

simple.targetSentence: We may not receive the delivery today.
simple.explanation: Subject + may not + base verb (receive) + the delivery today.

dialogue: Is that the CEO walking across the parking lot?
No, it ___ be her; she is attending a conference in Tokyo this week.
intermediate.explanation: Deduksi kemustahilan logis (pasti mustahil bukan dia): can't be her.
hints: Mustahil karena orangnya sedang di Tokyo.

intermediate.prompt: Why is the client hesitating? — They ___ waiting for board approval.
intermediate.explanation: Might be + verb-ing menyatakan kemungkinan spekulatif untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung.

intermediate.prompt: The lights in his study are still on; he ___ working late.
intermediate.explanation: Bukti fisik lampu menyala mendukung kesimpulan logis pasti: must be working late.
hints: Lampu menyala adalah bukti pendukung kuat.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat kemungkinan negatif dengan might not.
intermediate.targetSentence: The flight might not depart on time due to fog.
intermediate.explanation: The flight + might not + base verb (depart) + on time due to fog.
hints: Mulai dengan The flight might not.

intermediate.prompt: He has a thick Scottish accent; he ___ from Edinburgh.
intermediate.explanation: Deduksi kuat berdasarkan ciri aksen: must be from Edinburgh.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat kemungkinan alternatif dengan could be.
intermediate.targetSentence: The discrepancy could be an accounting error.
intermediate.explanation: Subject + could be + noun phrase (an accounting error).
hints: Mulai dengan The discrepancy could be.

dialogue: Are we confident in these revenue projections?
They are plausible, but market volatility ___ affect the bottom line.
intermediate.explanation: Could menyatakan potensi risiko kemungkinan masa depan.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan deduksi masa lalu yang keliru menggunakan present modal.
complex.draft: The team was celebrating yesterday; they must win the championship.
options: The team was celebrating yesterday; they must have won the championship.
The team was celebrating yesterday; they had to win the championship.
The team was celebrating yesterday; they must had won the championship.
complex.explanation: Deduksi logis masa lampau (past logical deduction) WAJIB menggunakan modal perfect: must have + V3 (must have won).

complex.prompt: The server crash ___ prevented if the redundancy protocol had been triggered.
complex.explanation: Kemampuan atau kemungkinan pasif di masa lampau yang tidak terwujud: could have been prevented.

complex.prompt: You ___ seen Sarah in New York yesterday; she was having dinner with me in London!
complex.explanation: Deduksi kemustahilan logis masa lampau (past impossibility): can't have + V3 (can't have seen).
hints: Mustahil karena orangnya ada di London kemarin.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat deduksi negatif masa lampau.
complex.targetSentence: He can't have stolen the documents.
complex.explanation: Subject + can't have + past participle (stolen) + the documents.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan antara might have dan should have pada penyesalan.
complex.draft: I didn't hear the alarm, so I might have missed the meeting.
options: I didn't hear the alarm, so I might miss the meeting.
I didn't hear the alarm, which is why I missed the meeting.
I didn't hear the alarm, so I may have missed the meeting.
complex.explanation: Klausa sebab-akibat fakta riil lampau (real past fact) tidak memerlukan modal spekulasi jika peristiwanya sudah pasti terjadi.
hints: Fakta riil bahwa pertemuan sudah terlewatkan.

complex.prompt: The ancient parchment ___ date back to the fourteenth century, according to recent radiocarbon testing.
complex.explanation: Idiom 'may well / could well' digunakan untuk menyatakan probabilitas kuat yang sangat mungkin benar.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog investigasi forensik dengan modal perfect.
dialogue: How did the intruder bypass the biometric gate?
The intruder ___ had inside assistance from an employee.
complex.explanation: Spekulasi kemungkinan masa lampau: might have + V3 (might have had).
